summary: Solaris Energy Infrastructure, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 Other Events. The filing discloses that a wholly owned subsidiary entered into an agreement to provide over 600 MW of power capacity, including balance of plant scope, to an affiliate of an investment-grade technology company. The term is 10 years, beginning in late 2026 and scaling through 2028. No financial terms, board recommendation, or deal mechanics are disclosed. This is a routine commercial contract, not a special situation. No transaction categories apply.
